title: SoFi Stadium Opens Early BTS Merch Sale Ahead of Los Angeles Shows
detail: August 31, 2026 — Ahead of BTS's four sold-out ARIRANG World Tour shows at SoFi Stadium (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6), the venue opened an early, non-event-day merchandise sale from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. at the Lake Park trailer near Lot N and at Lot K. Parking was free for the sale and opened at 8 a.m. via the Orange Zone Lot H entrance off Century and Yukon Avenue, though overnight parking and camping were not permitted. The pre-show sale comes as the tour's North American leg resumes after a three-day pause following the Chicago Soldier Field stand (Aug 27-28), with Los Angeles marking the tour's next stop.

media.caption: BTS's ARIRANG World Tour arrives at SoFi Stadium for four sold-out Los Angeles shows.
